rationale: Round 3's two runs differed only in synthesis script. AREA 3 stays port-limited: port delay ~7.2 ns, and port slack moves ~0.8 ns per ns of target, so its true period is near 9 ns. DELAY 1 shortened the port path (slack better than -0.54 vs -0.68) and gave the best T_eff, 8.70, now reg-to-reg-limited. Die size and margins shifted results only ~0.1-0.2 ns; DELAY 3/4 bloated wiring. Hold, DRC and slew/cap (0 vs 850) have headroom. Both settings keep the round-3 physical recipe at 8.16 ns and try the untested siblings DELAY 2 and DELAY 0, seeking DELAY 1's short port path with better reg-to-reg depth.
